newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes tumble on paper market losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes tumble on paper market losses.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes were pummelled Thursday, ending sharply lower in-line with the paper market declines witnessed on the NYMEX.
Cash markets were sidelined to some extent by the action in the futures, with deals for grades notably slowed by the fluctuations in outright prices.
March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing faded some 80 cents, ending at $23.00-10 a barrel, with the March/April roll down around 5 cts to 34-35 cts.
Confirmed trades in the grades were steady from Wednesday, though postings plus differentials dipped with the roll.
